newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOE UNIT LAUNCHES OFFSHORE UNIT TRUSTS.
newsitem.headline: BOE UNIT LAUNCHES OFFSHORE UNIT TRUSTS.

text.p: The Board of Executors Ltd (BOE), a South African financial services company, has set up an international arm to enable local investors to access foreign markets, it was announced on Wednesday.
The new arm, BOE International Asset Management Ltd (BOE), said in a statement unit trusts had been chosen as the vehicle for international investment.
"The unit trust option is a practical alternative to buying individual securities for each client," BOE executive director John Winship said.
"While we shall market to global investors we also wanted appropriate structures for our South African institutional clients who require global diversification of their domestic portfolios."

The first two unit trusts were the BOE International Growth Fund which would invest for capital growth in securities on foreign bourses, and the BOE International Managed Fund which would seek capital growth and a higher level of income.
The unit trusts would be managed by BOE International Unit Trusts, which had been formed by BOE.
